logline: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately after Episode 8, continuing the peaceful evening inside the cottage before an urgent knock shatters the calm.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana at the wooden table by candlelight, grinding dried herbs with a pestle inside a stone mortar.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana methodically crushes herbs in the mortar beside her open herbal grimoire.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander turning toward the doorway, his eyes sharp and vigilant.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Protective)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Stay back. I'll open it.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.

segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Frantic, Weeping)
segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
segments.text: Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.

segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent, Compassionate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Bring him here. Quickly.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.

segments.label: JULIANA (Reassuring, Focused)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.

segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious)
segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
segments.text: Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana resting two fingers against the boy's wrist, measuring his shallow pulse.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana lifts the weathered herbal book and rapidly browses the handwritten pages.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Insert close-up of the open page illustrated with botanical drawings labeled 'Feverfew'.

segments.label: JULIANA (Muttering, Intent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Feverfew... Not alone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile close-up of Juliana studying the grimoire's remedies intently while the mother weeps in the soft background.

segments.label: JULIANA (Determined)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Chamomile... and willow bark.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander leaning over the table, gazing at her with intense concern.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You're certain?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes with resolute conviction.

segments.label: JULIANA (Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I have to be.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana quickly grabs bundles of dried herbs from the table and turns to Alexander.

segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander, I need hot water.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Prompt)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I'm on it.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander hurries to the hearth and lifts a boiling iron kettle from the hearth chain, while the mother buries her face in her hands.

segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Sobbing)
segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
segments.text: Please save him.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander returns and pours steaming hot water into the stone mortar as Juliana prepares the remedy.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana clasping the mother's trembling hand across the wooden table.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Steadfast)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: He is not beyond saving.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana carefully administering the herbal brew with a small wooden spoon into the sick boy's mouth.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The child swallows weakly and lets out a soft cough.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the mother clutching her chest in anxious suspense.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana sitting quietly beside the boy, holding two fingers over his wrist to monitor his pulse.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the mother leaning across the table in panic.

segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Despairing)
segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
segments.text: Why isn't it working?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana raising a calm finger, urging patience.

segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Focused)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Wait.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the sleeping boy as beads of sweat form on his forehead, his breathing deepening.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the mother gently caressing her son's cheek, sobbing with relief.

segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Overcome with Emotion)
segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
segments.text: His fever... it's breaking.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana exhaling a deep breath of relief, smiling gently.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the mother looking up at Juliana with overwhelming gratitude.

segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Tearful, Grateful)
segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
segments.text: You saved him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana grasping the mother's hand with warm modesty.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Gracious)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: The herbs did their work. Let him rest.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana places a comforting hand over the mother's hands.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The mother gathers her sleeping son in her arms and steps back toward the rainy doorway.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot from inside the cottage framing the mother standing at the open door looking back.

segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Reverent, Vowing)
segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
segments.text: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The mother exits into the rainy twilight as Alexander pushes the door shut.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander turning from the door, his expression deeply troubled.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Stern, Warning)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana placing the mortar back onto the table, unflinching.

segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Principled)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, his jaw clenched with protective anxiety.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Dark, Cautionary)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot profile of Juliana stepping directly in front of Alexander, looking steadfastly up into his eyes.

segments.label: JULIANA (Committed, Unshakable)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Then we will face it together.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing the Blond Nobleman in the foreground as The Former Groom halts respectfully behind his chair.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Aloof, Without Looking Up)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: What is it?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Hesitant, Deferential)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Coldly Curious)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: What rumor?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Uneasy)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Arrogant)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Tense, Solemn)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sharp, Demanding)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Where?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Cautious)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: No one seems certain.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive, Masking Panic)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Then let it remain a rumor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Shaken)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Impossible.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.
